refer_earn_faq_limit_q: Is there a limit to how many people I can refer?
refer_earn_faq_limit_a: No — you can refer unlimited users and earn rewards for each successful referral.
refer_earn_faq_wallet_q: How can I use my wallet points?
refer_earn_faq_wallet_a:
You can use wallet points:
• While making any purchase
• While paying dues
Points will automatically be deducted from your wallet during checkout/payment.
refer_earn_faq_credited_q: When will the reward be credited?
refer_earn_faq_credited_a: Once the referee completes their first successful payment, the points will be credited instantly or as per the platform's confirmation time.
refer_earn_faq_receive_q: How will I receive my rewards?
refer_earn_faq_receive_a: Rewards are added to your user wallet as points. 1 Point = ₹1
refer_earn_faq_share_q: How do I share my referral link?
refer_earn_faq_share_a: You can copy and share your referral code or link from the Refer & Earn section in the app.
refer_earn_faq_withdraw_q: Can I withdraw wallet points as cash?
refer_earn_faq_withdraw_a: No. Points can be used only within the platform for purchases or dues, but cannot be withdrawn as cash.
refer_earn_faq_cancel_q: What happens if the referee cancels the payment?
refer_earn_faq_cancel_a: If the referee's first payment is refunded, cancelled, or failed, the referral reward will not be credited.
refer_earn_faq_later_q: Can the referee use my referral code later?
refer_earn_faq_later_a: No. The referee must use your referral code/link during registration to count toward your reward.
refer_earn_faq_amount_q: How much can I earn per referral?
refer_earn_faq_amount_a:
Your earnings depend on the referee's first payment amount:
₹1,000 → You earn ₹250
₹10,000 → You earn 2% of the amount
₹100 to ₹1,000 → You earn ₹50
refer_earn_faq_program_q: What is the Refer & Earn program?
refer_earn_faq_program_a: It's a reward program where you earn wallet points for every new user who signs up using your referral link and completes their first payment.

decline_restricted_details: Your card or bank account has restrictions on online payments or transaction limits.
decline_restricted_resolution: Please contact your bank's phone banking / card customer care team to lift this restriction, or pay using Net Banking or UPI.
decline_insufficient_details: The transaction failed because there are insufficient funds in your bank account.
decline_insufficient_resolution: Please add funds to your account, check your daily transaction limits, or try another payment method.
decline_do_not_honor_details: Your bank has declined this transaction (Do Not Honor response code 05). This is typical if online/international usage is disabled on your card.
decline_do_not_honor_resolution: Please log in to your bank's mobile app and enable online/e-commerce transactions under card controls, or call your bank's customer care.
decline_expired_details: The card details entered have expired or the expiry date was incorrect.
decline_expired_resolution: Please verify the expiry date on your physical card and try again, or use a valid active card.
decline_incorrect_details: The security details (CVV, PIN, or OTP) entered did not match the bank's records.
decline_incorrect_resolution: Please re-enter your card details carefully, verifying the CVV and OTP code sent by your bank.
decline_timeout_details: The connection with your issuing bank timed out or failed at the processing gateway.
decline_timeout_resolution: Please wait a few minutes and try again, or try paying via UPI / Net Banking which is often more stable.
decline_cancelled_details: The Net Banking transaction was cancelled or closed before completion.
decline_cancelled_resolution: Please try the payment again, and do not close or navigate away from the bank login screen until the process is fully complete.
decline_auth_failed_details: The Net Banking customer ID, password, or security credentials entered were incorrect.
decline_auth_failed_resolution: Please re-verify your Net Banking user ID/password, check your OTP, and try again.
decline_dormant_details: Your bank account is currently dormant or inactive for Net Banking / online transfers.
decline_dormant_resolution: Please contact your bank branch to activate your Net Banking service, or try paying via UPI/Card.

oldGoldTermsDescription:
1. Old Gold Scheme is valid for 11 months.
2. Gold ornaments deposited must be of acceptable purity.
3. Zero wastage and zero making charges are applicable only on gold ornaments purchased of the same weight upon maturity.
4. Scheme cannot be closed prematurely without applicable charges.
5. Government taxes and GST are extra as applicable at the time of purchase.
